verdict.line: You lose if you let Gwen poke from range and W away every time you commit; you win if you catch her with her Hallowed Mist down and end it before she resets.

brief.thesis: Darius vs Gwen (49.6% over 560 games, even) hinges entirely on one button: W (Hallowed Mist) makes her untargetable to anyone outside the mist, which hard-counters your E (Apprehend) hook and R (Noxian Guillotine) leap unless you're already standing in it. Every trade is really a question of whether that cooldown (22/21/20/19/18s) is up.

theirWindow.when: she has both E and W available
theirWindow.what: She dashes in with E (Skip 'n Slash) for the attack speed and range buff, throws Q (Snip Snip!) stacks, then drops W to vanish from your hook range if you try to punish. Don't chase into the mist edge — you'll eat true-damage center stacks of Q for nothing.

yourWindow.when: she just used W or it's on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in. Land E (Apprehend, cooldown 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s) to pull her in, stack Hemorrhage with Q (Decimate) and autos, and finish with R once she's near max stacks — she has no mist to hide behind.

start.why: 49.5% win rate over 574 games and the standard 84.4% pick — the lifesteal proc matters because Gwen's passive (A Thousand Cuts) punishes you for staying in extended trades, so you need sustain to match her healing.

boots.why: 50.3% over 386 games. Every source of Gwen's damage — Q, passive, R — is magic, so the flat magic resist directly reduces her main damage type across the whole game.

core.why: The active haste closes the gap on a kiting E user and lets you actually land E (Apprehend) before she resets Skip 'n Slash.
Stacking magic resist against a champion whose entire damage profile is magic — this is the single highest-impact defensive item in the matchup.
56.7% win rate over 30 games on this path. The damage-over-time conversion smooths out her burst windows from Q stacks and R hits.

runes.keystoneWhy: 51.9% win rate over the higher-performing page. Conqueror's healing offsets Gwen's constant %-health poke from her passive and Q stacks, letting you actually win extended trades instead of losing the war of attrition.

summoners.why: 52.5% win rate at 62% pick rate — the highest-performing combo. Ghost closes the gap on her E dash faster than Ignite's damage matters, since your kill pattern needs you to actually land E and R, not just poke.

playing.title: Track her W cooldown out loud
playing.detail: 22 seconds at rank 1 down to 18 at rank 5. If she just used Hallowed Mist to escape a trade or you saw her pop it defensively at a wave clash, that's your all-in window until it's back up.

playing.title: Never E into standing mist
playing.detail: If Gwen is already inside her own Hallowed Mist, she can't be targeted by anything outside it — your E (Apprehend) will whiff. Wait for her to leave it or force the fight before she can drop it.

playing.title: Punish her E cooldown, not her dash
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash refunds part of its cooldown if she hits you during the buff window, so don't trade into her after she dashes — back off and punish once the buff expires without a refund.

playing.title: Save R for max Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with stacks of Hemorrhage on the target. Land Q and autos first to load 4-5 stacks before committing R, since it's your only way through Force of Nature-level magic resist she may build back.

playing.title: Freeze when her E is down
playing.detail: Without Skip 'n Slash up, Gwen has no gap-closer or escape besides mist. Hold the wave near your tower and force her to walk up, then E-hook the instant she's in range.

playing.title: Respect Needlework range from level 6
playing.detail: Her R (Needlework, range 1200) can be cast up to three times and slows on every hit. Don't overextend past minions once she's level 6 even if you're ahead — it out-ranges your entire kit.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG data on the current patch (16.18.1) — the win rates, pick rates and sample sizes are real. The tactical reading of when to engage around Hallowed Mist and how the power curve shifts is my own analysis layered on top of that data.
